IndexRecommender – lightweight auto index recommendation engine
Records column access patterns via recordAccess() and then analyses them with recommend() to suggest indexes that would improve query performance.
The engine uses a simple scoring model: benefit_score = (filter_count × (1 – avg_selectivity) × 100) / total_queries

Recommendations with benefit_score > ADD_THRESHOLD are returned as ADD. Indexed columns that have never been accessed and have benefit_score < DROP_THRESHOLD are returned as DROP (requires the caller to supply existing_indexes).
Thread-safety: recordAccess() is thread-safe (uses a mutex). recommend() is also thread-safe.
Usage: IndexRecommender rec; rec.recordAccess("users", "email", IndexRecommender::AccessType::FILTER, 0.01); auto recs = rec.recommend("users");
